verse.verse_3: Lalle ne, Mũ, Muka saukar da shi a cikin wani dare mai albarka. Lalle Mũ' Mun kasance Mãsu yin gargaɗi.
verse.verse_4: A cikinsa (shi daren) ake rarrabe kõwane umurui bayyananne.
verse.verse_5: Umurni na daga wurinMu. Lalle Mũ ne Muka kasanceMãsu aikãwã.
verse.verse_6: Sabõda rahama daga Ubangijinka. Lalle Shĩ, Shi ne Mai ji, Mãsani.
verse.verse_7: (Shĩ ne) Ubangijin sammai da ƙasa da abin da ke a tsakãninsu, idan kun kasance mãsu yaƙĩni (za ku gãne haka).
verse.verse_8: Babu abin bautãwa fãce Shi. Yana rãyarwa Kuma Yana kashẽwa. (Shi ne) Ubangijinku, kuma Ubangijin ubanninku na farko.
verse.verse_9: A'a sũ, sunã wãsã a cikin shakka.
verse.verse_10: Sabõda haka, ka dakata rãnar da sama zã tã zo da hayãƙi bayyananne.
verse.verse_11: Yanã rufe mutãne. Wannan wata azãba ce mai raɗaɗi.
verse.verse_12: Ya Ubangijinmu! Ka kuranye mana azãba. Lalle Mũ, mãsu ĩmãni ne.
verse.verse_13: Inã tunãwa take a gare su, alhãli kuwa, haƙĩƙa, Manzo mai bayyanãwa Ya je musu (da gargaɗin saukar azãbar, ba su karɓa ba)?
verse.verse_14: Sa'an nan suka jũya baya daga gare shi, Kuma suka ce: "Wanda ake gayãwa ne, mahaukaci."
verse.verse_15: Lalle Mũ, Mãsu kuranyẽwar azãba ne, a ɗan lõkaci kaɗan, lalle kũ, mãsu kõmãwa ne (ga laifin).
verse.verse_16: Rãnar da Muke damƙa, damƙa mafi girma, lalle ne Mũ mãsu azãbar rãmuwa ne.
verse.verse_17: Kuma lalle ne haƙĩƙa a gabaninsu, Mun fitini mutãnen Fir'auna, kuma wani Manzo karĩmi ya jẽ musu.
verse.verse_18: (Mazon ya ce): "Ku kãwo mini (ĩmãninku) ya bayin Allah! Lalle ni, Manzo ne amintacce zuwa gare ku."
verse.verse_19: "Kuma kada ku nẽmi ɗaukaka a kan Allah. Lalle nĩ mai zo muku ne da dalĩli bayyananne."
verse.verse_20: "Kuma lalle nĩ na nẽmi tsari da Ubangijĩna, kuma Ubangijinku, dõmin kada ku jẽfe ni."
verse.verse_21: "Kuma idan ba ku yi ĩmãni sabõda nĩ ba, to, ku nĩsance ni."
verse.verse_22: Sai ya kirayi Ubangjinsa cẽwa waɗannan mutãnene mãsu laifi.
verse.verse_23: (Allah Ya ce): "To, ka yi tafiyar dare da bayiNa, da dare. Lalle kũ, waɗanda ake bĩ ne (dõmin a kãma ku.)"
verse.verse_24: "Kuma ka bar tẽku rarrabe. Lalle sũ, runduna ce abar nutsarwa."
verse.verse_25: Da yawa suka bar gõnaki da marẽmari.
verse.verse_26: Da shuke-shuke da matsayi mai kyau.
verse.verse_27: Da wata ni'ima da suka kasance a cikinta sunã mãsu hutu.
verse.verse_28: Kamar haka! Kuma Muka gãdar da ita ga waɗansu mutãne na dabam.
verse.verse_29: Sa'an nan samã da ƙasã ba su yi kũka a kansu ba, Kuma ba su kasance waɗanda ake yi wa jinkiri ba.
verse.verse_30: Kuma lalle ne, haƙĩƙa Mun tsĩrar da Banĩ Isrã'ĩla daga, azãba mai wulãkantãwa.
verse.verse_31: Daga Fir'auna. Lalle shi, ya kasance maɗaukaki daga cikin mãsu ɓarna.
verse.verse_32: Kuma lalle ne, haƙĩƙa, Mun zãɓe su sabõda wani ilmi (na Taurata) a kan mutãne.
verse.verse_33: Kuma Muka bã su, daga ãyõyin mu'ujizõji, abin da yake a cikinsa, akwai ni'ima bayyananna
verse.verse_34: Lalle waɗannan mutãne, haƙĩka, sunã cẽwa,
verse.verse_35: "Babu wani abu sai mutuwarmu ta farko, kuma ba mu zama waɗanda ake tãyarwa ba."
verse.verse_36: "Sai ku zo da ubanninmu, idan kun kasance mãsu gaskiya."
verse.verse_37: shin, sũ ne mafĩfĩta kõ kuwa mutãnen Tubba'u, kuma da waɗanda ke a gabãninsu? Mun halaka su, lalle sũ, sun kasance mãsu laifi.
verse.verse_38: Kuma ba Mu halitta slmmai da ƙasa da abin da ke a tsakãninsu ba, alhãli kuwa Munã mãsu wãsã.
verse.verse_39: Ba Mu halitta su ba fãce da manufa ta gaskiya, kuma amma mafi yawansu, ba su sani ba.
verse.verse_40: Lalle rãnar rarrabẽwa, ita ce lõkacin wa'adinsu gabã ɗaya.
verse.verse_41: Rãnar da wani zumu bã ya amfãnin wani zumu da kõme kuma ba su zama anã taimakon su ba.
verse.verse_42: fãce wanda Allah Ya yi wa rahama. Lalle Shi (Allah), shĩ ne Mabuwãyi, Mai jin ƙai.
verse.verse_45: Kamar narkakken kwalta yanã tafasa a cikin cikunna.
verse.verse_47: (A cẽ wa malã'ikun wutã), "Ku kãmã shi, sa'an nan ku fizge shi zuwa ga tsakiyar Jahĩm."
verse.verse_48: "Sa'an nan ku zuba, a kansa, daga azãbar ruwan zãfi."
verse.verse_49: (A ce masã), "Ka ɗanɗana! Lalle kai, kai ne mabuwãyi mai girma!"
verse.verse_50: "Lalle wannan, shi ne abin da kuka kasance kunã shakka game da shi."
verse.verse_51: Lalle mãsu taƙawa sunã cikin matsayi amintacce.
verse.verse_52: A cikin gidãjen Aljanna da marẽmari.
verse.verse_53: Sunã tufanta daga tufãfin alharĩni raƙĩƙi, da mai kauri, sunã mãsu zaman fuskantar jũna.
verse.verse_54: Kamar haka, kuma Mun aurar da su da mãtã mãsu kyaun idãnu, mãsu girmansu.
verse.verse_55: Sunã kira, a cikinsu (gidẽjen) ga dukan 'ya'yan itãcen marmari, sunã amintattu (daga dukan abin tsõro).
verse.verse_56: Bã su ɗanɗanar mutuwa, a cikinsu, fãce mutuwar farko, kuma (Allah), Ya tsare musu azãbar Jahĩm.
verse.verse_57: Sabõda falala daga Ubangijinka. Wancan shi ne babban rabo, mai girma.
verse.verse_58: Dõmin haka kawai Muka sauƙaƙar da shi (Alƙur'ãni) da harshenka, tsammãninsu, su riƙa tunãwa.
verse.verse_59: Sai ka yi jira. Lalle sũ, mãsu jira ne.
